systems.tiers: Birth, marriage and death acts can be collected at any commune or administrative annex across the national territory, or via internet; the family civil-status sheet is issued immediately at any commune or annex

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités locales et des Transports
systems.tiers: Online requests for a marriage appointment and for rectification of keying errors in civil-status acts

note: A standing ministry service page (post dated 2024-02-29). It says declarations of birth and death are made at the commune and that acts are delivered at any commune or online, and it distinguishes a keying error (erreur de saisie), corrected by the civil registrar, from an error made in transcribing the act on the register, corrected by the courts; it does not say where or when the digital entry is made, nor that events are registered digitally at the office, so no civil fact and no `made` fact is recorded.
